name: Marbella (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of blue, white, light blue, white and blue with a broad light blue central stripe.
history: The design of the arms and flag of Marbella used by the town council is a matter of controversy; according to some sources these symbols were changed without consensus or heraldic rigour by the GIL party and were not processed before the Junta de Andalucía, so that various sectors call for the rehabilitation of the arms granted to the city by the Catholic Monarchs in 1493.
